name: Cozy Medieval Tavern
description: Warm oak interior, hearth fire, long tables and lantern light.
palette: aged cream, warm beige, ochre, honey brown, dark walnut wood, muted grey stone
lighting: soft warm hearth and lantern light, gentle directional shadows
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: wide oak plank flooring with visible grain, knots and spilled-ale stains
materials: A medieval tavern's ground floor seen from directly above, with the roof and the whole upper floor taken away. Wide oak plank floors with visible grain and knots, timber-framed plaster walls, a large stone hearth with a crackling fire, long trestle tables and benches, a polished bar counter with ale barrels behind it, iron lanterns standing on the tables and along the bar, woven rugs and clutter of mugs and crockery.
